title: 移動式多灯手術灯外装
description: 診療・処置室の背景に置く移動式多灯照明外装。五本脚と車輪、伸縮支柱外形、平行リンク式の固定腕と軸、七つの個別レンズ面を持つ円形ヘッド、左右の把持部、曲線状の固定電源線を造形。レンズは不透明・非発光PBRで、スポット追尾灯とは異なる医療照明風の外観です。照度・電装・調整・医療安全性能を実装または検証した器具ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.843 × 2.128 × 1.777 m、19,304三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A mobile multi-lens light exterior for clinical treatment-room backgrounds. It has a five-spoke caster base, telescoping-style mast, fixed parallel-link arms/pivots, round head with seven individual lens faces, side handles and curved fixed power cord. Lenses are opaque non-emissive PBR surfaces; the medical-lighting exterior differs from a followspot. Illumination, electrical behavior, adjustment and medical-safety performance are not implemented or validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.843 × 2.128 × 1.777 m; 19,304 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
